footnote_text: Represents shares underlying a pro-rated phantom stock award in respect of the annual retainer granted to the reporting person on November 2, 2026, for service as a member of the Board of Directors (the "Board") of the Issuer. The shares vest in full on the earlier of the business day immediately preceding the date of the Issuer's next annual stockholders' meeting and the date of such reporting person's departure from the Board. The shares will be settled promptly following the date on which the reporting person ceases to serve as a director.

The shares vest in full on the earlier of the business day immediately preceding the date of the Issuer's next annual stockholders' meeting and the date of such reporting person's departure from the Board. The shares will be settled promptly following the date on which the reporting person ceases to serve as a director.

Represents the pro-rated equity portion of the annual retainer, in the form of restricted stock units ("RSUs"), granted to the reporting person on November 2, 2026, for service as a member of the Board of Directors (the "Board") of the Issuer. The RSUs vest in full on the earlier of the business day immediately preceding the date of the Issuer's next annual stockholders' meeting and the date of such reporting person's departure from the Board.
